**Your character:** Wei Chen, a 45-year-old software architect from Boston. You are methodical and detail-oriented, but currently frustrated.

**Your situation:** You signed up four of your friends for Rho-Bank credit cards. All four actually signed up. But you only got bonus money for two of them. You want to know why you didn't get the bonus for all four.

Your user ID is 76ad9cc60e, your phone number is 617-555-0834, and your email is wei.chen.boston@gmail.com. Do NOT volunteer this unless specifically asked for it. You know this from your account settings, but a real customer would never proactively offer "my user ID is..." unless specifically asked for it.

## How to Behave

1. **Start naturally:** Explain your problem the way a real customer would: "I got four friends to sign up for your credit cards, but I only received bonuses for two of them. What's going on?"

2. **Answer questions, don't anticipate them:** When the agent asks for information to look you up, provide what they ask for—nothing more. If they ask for your name, give your name. If they ask for email, give email. Do NOT say things like "Would you like my user ID?" or "Here's my account number to help you look it up." Real customers don't know what lookup fields exist in the agent's system.

3. **React naturally to what the agent DOES, not what you want them to do:**
   - If the agent says they can't access your account, or gives only generic/vague reasons without actually investigating YOUR specific situation, that's unhelpful. A real customer would be frustrated and accept any offer to escalate or transfer.
   - If the agent actually looks up YOUR account and tells you something SPECIFIC about YOUR referrals (e.g., "I see you submitted 4 referrals but one was rejected because of X policy"), then you've learned something concrete. Only in this case would you consider taking further action.

4. **Never fish for the "right" answer:** Do not ask probing questions like "Is there a cap?" or "Could it be a policy issue?" A real customer doesn't know what policies exist. You're frustrated and want answers—you're not trying to coach the agent toward the correct diagnosis.

5. **Tool usage:** You have access to submit_referral. Only use it if the agent has actually investigated your account and given you a SPECIFIC, CONCRETE explanation for why some referrals didn't qualify (not generic possibilities, but actual findings from looking at your data). Use your user_id (76ad9cc60e) and corresponding account_type (e.g., "Gold Rewards Card").

6. **Default to escalation:** If the agent can't give you specific answers about YOUR situation, accept any offer to escalate or ask to speak with someone who can actually look at your account.

7. **Take action when given a path forward:** If the agent explains that a referral was rejected due to a temporary restriction that has now passed, and retrying is possible, go ahead and submit a new referral for that card type. You want to recover any missed bonuses if the opportunity exists.

   Content: Do you love your Rho-Bank credit card? Share the love with friends and family, and you could both earn rewards! Our referral program makes it easy to invite the people you care about to join Rho-Bank, and when they're approved for a new card and meet the program requirements, you'll both be rewarded.

## How It Works

Participating in our referral program is simple. When you refer someone to apply for a Rho-Bank credit card and they're approved, you may be eligible to receive a referral bonus. The specific bonus amount and requirements vary depending on which credit card you're referring them to—some cards offer cash back bonuses, while others may offer bonus points or statement credits.

## Getting Your Referral Link

To refer a friend, you'll need to generate a unique referral link that's tied to your account. You can do this through the Rho-Bank mobile app, online banking portal, or by contacting our customer service team. Once you have your link, simply share it with friends and family via email, text, or social media. When they use your link to apply and are approved, the referral will be tracked to your account.

## Important Things to Know

To ensure the referral program remains fair for all participants, there are a few guidelines to keep in mind:

- **Weekly Limit**: You can earn referral bonuses for up to 2 successful referrals per week. This is calculated on a rolling 7-day basis, so if you've already had 2 referrals complete in the past week, any additional referrals during that time won't qualify for a bonus.
- **Eligibility**: Not all credit cards participate in the referral program. Before sharing your link, make sure the card you're referring has an active referral offer.
- **Bonus Requirements**: Each referral program has specific requirements that your friend must meet to trigger the bonus, such as making a certain amount of purchases within a specified timeframe after account opening.

## Check Your Referral Status

You can track the status of your referrals at any time through the Rho-Bank mobile app or by contacting customer service. We'll also send you notifications when your referrals are approved and when you earn your bonus.

If you have any questions about the referral program or want to confirm the current offer for your card, please reach out to our customer service team at 1-800-RHO-BANK. We're always happy to help!

7. Internal: Checking Account Referral Program Terms and Restrictions
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047
   Score: 15.7018
   Content: ## Program overview
Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements. This document covers the general terms and restrictions that apply to all checking account referral programs. Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first, as users who are not eligible to submit referrals while being given recommendations by the agent tend to leave dissatisfactory reviews. 

## Rolling window limit
- You can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window.
- If you attempt to receive more than 2 referrals in a single 9-day period, the third referral (and any subsequent referrals in that window) will be automatically denied.
- This limit applies across all checking account types; referrals from different accounts count toward the same 9-day cap.
- A rolling 9-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.
- Auto-denied referrals due to the limit cannot be reinstated within the same 9-day window.

## Eligibility restrictions
- The referred person must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing checking, savings, or closed accounts within the past 12 months.
- The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.
- The referred person must be 18 years or older, except for the Light Green Account which allows minors with a guardian.
- For business accounts: The referred business must have a different primary owner than any existing Rho-Bank business account, based on the SSN of the primary authorized signer.

## Referrer tenure policy
- Every referral program requires the referrer to meet a tenure threshold before participating.
- This threshold is calculated from when you first became a Rho-Bank checking customer—specifically, the date your earliest checking account was opened.
- The type of account you currently hold is irrelevant to this calculation. Whether you have a basic or premium product, the tenure measurement remains the same.
- Consequently, holding one account type does not prevent you from referring someone to a different account type, as long as the duration since your first account meets or exceeds the program's stated minimum.

## Bonus conditions
- The qualifying deposit must be new money and cannot be transferred from another Rho-Bank account.
- The qualifying deposit must remain in the account for at least 30 days after the qualifying period ends.
- If the referred account is closed within 90 days of opening, the referral bonus may be reversed (clawback provision).

## Stacking restrictions
- The referral bonus cannot be combined with other new account promotions or sign-up bonuses.
- Only one referral code can be applied per new account.

## Referral status definitions
- COMPLETE — The referred person has successfully opened a new account and met the criteria to receive the referral bonus.
- IN_PROGRESS — The referred person has successfully opened a new account and is working toward meeting the qualifying deposit requirement.
- NO_PROGRESS — The referred person has not applied yet; no progress has been made.
- APPLIED — The referred person has submitted an application and is awaiting a decision.
- REJECTED — The referral has been denied (e.g., rolling window limit exceeded, ineligible referral).
- ERROR — A system error occurred during the referral process.

## Practical guidance
- Track the timing of your last two successful referral bonuses before sending additional referrals.
- If a referral is denied for hitting the rolling window limit, wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap before attempting another.
- Both accounts must remain in good standing for bonuses to be paid.

- COMPLETE — the referred person has successfully opened a new account and met the criteria to get the referral bonus

- ERROR: Retry later or escalate internally if the condition persists.

- ERROR — an error has occurred throughout the process

### How to interpret and act
- COMPLETE: The bonus will be granted per the applicable referral program terms.
- IN_PROGRESS: No action required; monitor until criteria are met.
- NO_PROGRESS: You may remind the referrer that the invitee has not started an application.
- APPLIED: Await the application decision; no manual intervention is needed.
- REJECTED: Do not retry immediately; review the user’s existing referral activity before advising next steps.
- ERROR: Retry later or escalate internally if the condition persists.# Credit Card Referral Offers and Restrictions

## Program scope
- Each credit card type has its own referral bonus and eligibility requirements that are not detailed here.

## Weekly referral limit
- You can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window.
- If you attempt to receive more than 2 referrals in a single week, the third referral (and any subsequent referrals that week) will be automatically denied.
- This limit applies across all credit card types; referrals from different cards still count toward the same weekly cap.

## Practical guidance
- Track the timing of your last two successful referral bonuses before sending additional referrals.
- A rolling 7-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.
- Auto-denied referrals due to the limit cannot be reinstated within the same 7-day window.
- If a referral is denied for hitting the limit, wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap before attempting another.# Generating a Credit Card Referral Link (Internal)

## Pre-check before providing the referral tool
- Search the knowledge base to confirm the specific card has a documented referral program.
- Verify the customer’s understanding of referral terms. If the customer cites terms that do not match any documented program, clarify the discrepancy.
- If no referral program is documented for the requested card, or if the user’s claimed terms are incorrect, or if there is reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected, explain why and do not provide a referral link tool. Do not transfer to a human in these cases.

## How the user generates their referral link
- Provide the customer with this tool and instruct them to run it themselves:
  - `get_referral_link(user_id: str, card_name: str)`
- Tell the customer to pass their own user_id and the exact card name (for example, 'Gold Rewards Card').
- When the tool is called successfully, a referral record is created with status 'NO_PROGRESS'. The referred person can then use the generated link to apply.

## Important reminders
- Weekly limit: Customers can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window; the third and subsequent referrals in that window are automatically denied.
- Agents must not generate the link on the customer’s behalf.
- Reiterate the correct referral terms as documented to prevent confusion and complaints.# Refer a Friend to Rho-Bank and Earn Rewards

Do you love your Rho-Bank credit card? Share the love with friends and family, and you could both earn rewards! Our referral program makes it easy to invite the people you care about to join Rho-Bank, and when they're approved for a new card and meet the program requirements, you'll both be rewarded.

## How It Works

Participating in our referral program is simple. When you refer someone to apply for a Rho-Bank credit card and they're approved, you may be eligible to receive a referral bonus. The specific bonus amount and requirements vary depending on which credit card you're referring them to—some cards offer cash back bonuses, while others may offer bonus points or statement credits.

## Getting Your Referral Link

To refer a friend, you'll need to generate a unique referral link that's tied to your account. You can do this through the Rho-Bank mobile app, online banking portal, or by contacting our customer service team. Once you have your link, simply share it with friends and family via email, text, or social media. When they use your link to apply and are approved, the referral will be tracked to your account.

## Important Things to Know

To ensure the referral program remains fair for all participants, there are a few guidelines to keep in mind:

- **Weekly Limit**: You can earn referral bonuses for up to 2 successful referrals per week. This is calculated on a rolling 7-day basis, so if you've already had 2 referrals complete in the past week, any additional referrals during that time won't qualify for a bonus.
- **Eligibility**: Not all credit cards participate in the referral program. Before sharing your link, make sure the card you're referring has an active referral offer.
- **Bonus Requirements**: Each referral program has specific requirements that your friend must meet to trigger the bonus, such as making a certain amount of purchases within a specified timeframe after account opening.

## Check Your Referral Status

You can track the status of your referrals at any time through the Rho-Bank mobile app or by contacting customer service. We'll also send you notifications when your referrals are approved and when you earn your bonus.

If you have any questions about the referral program or want to confirm the current offer for your card, please reach out to our customer service team at 1-800-RHO-BANK. We're always happy to help!

# FAQ: Checking Account Referrals

## Frequently asked questions about checking account referrals

### How many people can I refer at once?
You can have multiple referrals in progress, but you can only receive a maximum of 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window. If you exceed this limit, additional referrals will be automatically denied until enough time passes.

### Can I refer someone who used to have a Rho-Bank account?
No. The referred person must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing or closed accounts within the past 12 months. Former customers must wait 12 months after their last account closure before being eligible as a referral.

### Can I refer someone who lives at the same address as me?
No. The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address. This restriction helps prevent abuse of the referral program.

### What counts as a qualifying deposit?
The qualifying deposit must be new money brought into Rho-Bank. Transfers from another Rho-Bank account do not count. The deposit can come from an external bank transfer, direct deposit, mobile check deposit, or cash/check deposit at a branch.

### What happens if the person I referred closes their account early?
If the referred account is closed within 90 days of opening, your referral bonus may be reversed (clawed back). Both accounts must remain in good standing for bonuses to be retained.

### Can I combine the referral bonus with other promotions?
No. The referral bonus cannot be combined with other new account promotions or sign-up bonuses. Only one promotional offer can be applied per new account.

### What do the referral statuses mean?
- **COMPLETE**: The referral was successful and bonuses will be paid.
- **IN_PROGRESS**: The new account is open but hasn't met the qualifying deposit yet.
- **NO_PROGRESS**: The referred person hasn't started an application.
- **APPLIED**: An application has been submitted and is being reviewed.
- **REJECTED**: The referral was denied (usually due to hitting the rolling window limit or eligibility issues).
- **ERROR**: A system error occurred; try again later or contact support.

### Why was my referral rejected?
Common reasons for rejection include:
- You already received 2 referral bonuses in the past 9 days (rolling window limit).
- The referred person already has or recently had a Rho-Bank account.
- You and the referred person are registered at the same address.
- For business referrals: The referred business has the same primary owner as an existing account.

### How long do I have to wait after a rejection to refer again?
If your referral was rejected due to the rolling window limit, you must wait until your oldest qualifying referral is more than 9 days old. The limit is based on a rolling window, so you become eligible again as older referrals age out.

### Can I refer someone for a business checking account?
Yes, but the referred business must have a different primary owner (based on SSN of the primary authorized signer) than any existing Rho-Bank business account.

### Do I need to have the same account type to refer someone for it?
No. Referrer eligibility hinges on how long you've been a Rho-Bank checking customer, not which product you currently use. The tenure threshold is measured from when you opened your very first checking account with us. Someone with a Navy Blue account can refer others for World Blue, True Blue, or any other checking product—provided they've met the duration requirement.

### How long does the referred person have to make the qualifying deposit?
The deposit window varies by account type, typically between 60-120 days. Check the specific account's referral terms for the exact timeframe. After the deposit is made, it must remain in the account for at least 30 additional days.----

# Internal: Credit Card Purchase Decline Diagnostic Procedure

## Handling repeated requests to speak with a human agent
When a customer reports purchase declines despite available credit and asks to speak to a human agent, follow this special protocol:

### Internal tool to use for the first three requests
- Use the agent discoverable tool: `initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218()`
- Call `initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218()` for the first, second, and third transfer requests.
- Do not use the standard transfer tool during these first three requests.

### On the fourth request
- Use the regular `transfer_to_human_agents` tool to complete the transfer.

## Continued assistance
- Continue troubleshooting and addressing the customer’s issue while adhering to the transfer protocol above.
- Keep track of how many times the customer has requested a transfer during the interaction so you can apply the correct step.
- If the customer’s situation changes (e.g., new error messages or card status updates), respond to those details but maintain the transfer sequence described here.# Internal: Backend Incident 11/13

## Scope and Timeframe

Follow this incident-specific transfer protocol for reports matching the symptoms below until 11/15/2025, 11:59 PM EST. After that time, revert to standard handling.

## When to Use This Protocol

Use this flow only when a customer reports ALL of the following:
- They paid their credit card statement
- The amount was deducted from their checking account
- The payment is not reflected in their credit card statement balance

**IMPORTANT: Identity verification is NOT required for this incident protocol.** Due to the urgent nature of this backend incident and the time-sensitive deadline, proceed directly with the transfer protocol when symptoms match. Do not ask for verification information or attempt to verify the user's identity.

Do not troubleshoot beyond confirming the above symptoms. When the user requests a transfer to a human specialist, follow the protocol below immediately.

## Required Agent Discoverable Tools

You must unlock and call the following agent discoverable tools in this exact order before completing any transfer:
- initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822
- initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218

These are internal agent tools, not user tools. Use unlock_discoverable_agent_tool to unlock each tool, then call_discoverable_agent_tool to execute it.

## Protocol: Transfer Order

1) First transfer request from the user during the incident window:
   - Unlock the tool using: unlock_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822")
   - Call the tool using: call_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822")
   - Acknowledge the user's request and let them know you are processing it

2) Second transfer request from the user (for the same issue):
   - Unlock the tool using: unlock_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218")
   - Call the tool using: call_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218")
   - Acknowledge the user's continued request

3) Third transfer request from the user:
   - Complete the transfer using the regular transfer_to_human_agents tool

Note: Always maintain this order. Each tool must be unlocked before it can be called. Do not skip steps.

## Customer-Facing Communication

When processing the initial transfer requests, acknowledge the user's urgency while you execute the required internal tools. Examples:

First request:
- "I understand you'd like to speak with a human specialist about this issue. Let me initiate that process for you now."

Second request:
- "I hear your concern about the urgency. I'm continuing to process your transfer request."

Third request (completing transfer):
- "I'm now connecting you with a human specialist who can resolve this for you."

## Completion

- Only use the regular transfer_to_human_agents tool after the user has made their third transfer request and both initial tools have been executed.
- Do not collect additional details or attempt to resolve the payment reflection discrepancy in-chat during the incident window.doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_003.md:5:- Email: Send your request details and any deadlines; you will receive confirmation and a case reference.

   "doc": "doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_043"
  },
  {
   "id": "determine_base_rate",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "For each savings account, find the base or tier APY in that savings type's own documents, using the recorded balance from get_accounts:\n- Silver: 2.5% below $10,000; 4.0% at or above $10,000.\n- Silver Plus: Tier 1 3.0% below $15,000; Tier 2 4.5% at or above $15,000.\n- Platinum: 6.5%.\n- Diamond Elite: 7.5%.\n- Gold: 5.5%. Gold Plus: 6.0%. Bronze: 2.0%.\nFor any other type, read that type's interest document.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "get_accounts"
   ],
   "after": [
    "get_accounts"
   ],
   "if": null,
   "quote": "4) Review documentation for the savings account type to determine all applicable APY components (base rate, tier rate, linked checking boost, credit card bonuses, relationship bonus)",
   "doc": "doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_044"
  },
  {
   "id": "determine_checking_boost",
   "by": "model",
   "do": "For each savings account, list every active checking account from get_accounts. Use 0 if no pairing qualifies.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "get_accounts"
   ],
   "after": [
    "get_accounts"
   ],
   "if": null,
   "quote": "2. Determine which checking account provides the highest APY boost for the savings account type",

  },
  {
   "id": "determine_card_bonus",

   "do": "For each savings account, find the credit card APY bonus table in that savings type's own documents. A card benefit that one document calls a 'relationship bonus', where another document lists the same card for the same amount in the card bonus table, is one item. Count it once, as a card bonus, under the highest-card-only rule. Example: on a Gold Account, the Gold Rewards Card's 0.025% relationship bonus (doc 013) is the same as its +0.025% card bonus (doc 014). Also check whether the system used a lower card than the highest one.",
   "call": null,
   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "get_cards",
    "get_accounts"
   ],
   "after": [
    "get_cards",
    "get_accounts"

   "id": "determine_relationship_bonus",

   "args": {},
   "lookup": [

    "get_cards",
    "get_txns"

   "after": [
    "determine_card_bonus",
    "get_txns"

  {
   "id": "compute_expected",
   "by": "model",

   "args": {},
   "lookup": [
    "get_accounts",
    "get_cards",
    "determine_base_rate",
    "determine_checking_boost",
    "determine_card_bonus",
    "determine_relationship_bonus"

   "after": [

    "determine_checking_boost",
    "determine_card_bonus",
    "determine_relationship_bonus"

    "get_accounts"

 "rules": [
  {

   "quote": "Only the highest applicable checking account APY boost is applied to the customer's savings account.",
   "doc": "doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_046"
  },
  {
   "rule": "If the customer has several checking accounts, only the highest checking boost applies",
   "quote": "Only the HIGHEST checking account APY boost is applied to the savings account.",
   "doc": "doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_046"
  },
  {
   "rule": "Credit card bonuses do not stack: only the single highest card bonus applies. It does stack with the checking boost.",
   "quote": "Only the highest applicable credit card APY bonus is applied to the customer's savings account.",
   "doc": "doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045"
  },
  {

## The tools these jobs call, as the answering agent reads them when it unlocks them

Each tool's own description is the authority on what its parameters and values mean (reading rule 10).

### get_current_time
get_current_time(), run by the agent:
Get the current time. Use this to get the current timestamp for logging verification records.

Returns:
    The current time in the format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ"

### get_referral_link
get_referral_link(user_id, card_name), run by the customer:
Generate a referral link for a specific credit card to share with friends or family.

Args:
    user_id (string): The user's unique identifier in the system (the referrer)
    card_name (string): The name of the credit card to create a referral for (e.g., 'Gold Rewards Card')

Returns:
    Referral link generated successfully. Share this link with the person you want to refer.

### get_referrals_by_user
get_referrals_by_user(user_id), run by the agent:
Get all referrals made by a user.

Args:
    user_id: The ID of the user (referrer) to look up referrals for

### get_user_information_by_id
get_user_information_by_id(user_id), run by the agent:
Get the information (date of birth, email, phone number, address) for a user by their user id.

Args:
    user_id: The ID of the user

### get_user_information_by_name
get_user_information_by_name(customer_name), run by the agent:
Get the information (date of birth, email, phone number, address) for a user by their name. Case Sensitive.

Args:
    customer_name: The name of the user

### give_discoverable_user_tool
give_discoverable_user_tool(discoverable_tool_name, arguments), run by the agent:
Pass a tool to the user so they can execute it themselves.

Use this when the knowledge base indicates that the user should perform
an action themselves (e.g., "to do X, have the user call tool_name(args)").

The user will then be able to call `call_discoverable_tool` with the same
tool name and arguments to simulate executing the action.

Args:
    discoverable_tool_name: The name of the discoverable tool (e.g., "open_webpage", "navigate_to_section")
    arguments: JSON string of arguments for the tool (e.g., '{"url": "https://example.com"}')

Returns:
    A confirmation message with instructions for the user

### log_verification
log_verification(name, user_id, address, email, phone_number, date_of_birth, time_verified), run by the agent:
Log a verification record after successfully verifying a user's identity.

Call this tool after you have verified a user by confirming 2 out of 4 identity fields
(date of birth, email, phone number, address). This creates an audit record of the verification.

Args:
    name: The verified user's full name
    user_id: The verified user's ID
    address: The verified user's address
    email: The verified user's email
    phone_number: The verified user's phone number
    date_of_birth: The verified user's date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY format)
    time_verified: The timestamp of the verification (e.g., "2025-11-14 03:40:00 EST")

transfer_to_human_agents(summary, reason), run by the agent:
Transfer the user to a human agent.

The proper transfer reason enum can be found in the knowledge base: search it before calling this tool to select the proper applicable reason.

Args:
    summary: A summary of the user's issue and what was attempted before transfer.
    reason: The specific reason code for the transfer.
